items.myDerivation: As printed (page 6 of the 24A-B PDF): lim x^4 / int_0^{x^2} t cos(t^2) dt = x^4/((1/2) sin(x^4)) -> 2. Numerics: x=0.1 gives 2.0000000033. The printed solution (page 7) solves a different limit (numerator sin^2 x, answer infinity): an official mismatch that does not apply to the printed question.
items.notes: Confirmed: the exam prints x^4 in the numerator; the stored solution solves it as printed, answer 2, correct. The stored text correctly flags the official page-7 solution as a different problem.
